item.dc:creator: Stan Choe
item.description: The US stock market has erased its early losses after absorbing big swings for Nvidia’s stock and oil prices.
item.title: ASX set to slide, Nvidia dives to weigh on Wall Street; Trump sends oil higher

item.dc:creator: Jonathan Rivett
item.description: The job market in Australia has fundamentally changed over the last few years. With that change has come a new set of conventions in the job application process.
item.title: Nobody reads my job applications anyway. Why should I put the effort in?

item.dc:creator: Millie Muroi
item.description: Most Australians feeling the cost-of-living crunch are continuing to spend on non-essentials. It’s not an irrational response.
item.title: We’re supposed to be struggling, yet we’re spending more. Why?

item.dc:creator: Calum Jaspan
item.description: The media tycoon’s appearance at an event in New York was followed by former employee Siobhan McKenna’s farewell bash before she jets off to the same city.
item.title: Rupert Murdoch makes a death-defying appearance

item.dc:creator: Nicole Lindsay
item.description: Metricon is moving house, shifting its head office to Ferntree Business Park in Notting Hill.
item.title: Australia’s biggest home builder gets itself ... a bigger home

item.dc:creator: Nick Toscano
item.description: Motorists are finally seeing some relief at the petrol pump as the cost of crude oil falls 20 per cent this month.
item.title: Bowser relief: Petrol prices tumble as global oil cost falls

item.dc:creator: Erin Griffith, Don Clark
item.description: Lori Huang has been by Jensen Huang’s side for decades but has kept a low profile as he built his fledgling start-up into one of the most valuable companies in the world. That all changed this week.
item.title: Nvidia billionaire’s affair scandal drags his wife of 41 years into the spotlight

item.dc:creator: Staff reporters
item.description: The Australian sharemarket has finished little changed amid new uncertainty for global markets, with reports Nvidia is preparing to oust its CEO and founder Jensen Huang.
item.title: ASX treads water as Nvidia scandal rocks AI sector; Xero soars

item.dc:creator: Murray Ward
item.description: Capability X has defied weak IPO conditions and global AI stock jitters, surging almost 50% to close at 29c on ASX debut after raising $12 million to expand its industrial safety technology.
item.title: Capability X defies AI blues with stellar ASX debut

item.dc:creator: Doug Bright
item.description: Auric Mining has locked in $17 million to accelerate its WA gold growth strategy, including drilling at its Munda, Union Jack and newly acquired Iron Maiden projects.
item.title: Auric pockets $17M for broad WA gold growth

item.dc:creator: Murray Ward
item.description: Flagship Minerals secured an option over the district-scale Fortuna Valle copper-gold project in Chile’s prolific Coquimbo region, boasting widespread historical drill hits.
item.title: Flagship bags district-scale Chilean copper-gold project

item.dc:creator: Tim Duggan
item.description: The ‘peanut butter raise’ usually gets spread evenly, but there are always a few extra crunchy bits for those who can make the right case.
item.title: Want a bigger pay rise? You’re probably making this mistake

item.dc:creator: Andrew Todd
item.description: Dalaroo Metals is set to drill its high-grade Bondoukou gold discovery in Côte d’Ivoire, with a rig now mobilising to site to test extensions of an 18m hit grading 7.31 g/t gold.
item.title: Dalaroo fires up diamond drill hunt for African gold riches

item.dc:creator: Nick Bonyhady
item.description: Nvidia’s board is believed to be meeting to discuss the future of its founder and CEO following reports of multiple extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy.
item.title: Nvidia ‘preparing to oust’ Jensen Huang, allegation of second affair emerges

item.dc:creator: Murray Ward
item.description: Miro Sciences has cleared a TGA manufacturing hurdle for its Crohn’s trial, with the regulator inspecting its partner’s facility ahead of a planned Phase 2 study for its StemSmart cell therapy.
item.title: Miro clears TGA audit ahead of Crohn’s disease trial

item.dc:creator: Stephen Bartholomeusz
item.description: The scare over a liquidity crisis in a state-owned company in Guangdong has rippled through China’s debt markets and shone a light on the financial pressure in its local governments.
item.title: China’s property implosion has further to go, and markets are worried

item.dc:creator: Elias Visontay
item.description: The corporate regulator has started legal proceedings against the nation’s biggest bank, alleging that it misled 42,000 business customers and overcharged them about $8.5 million in fees.
item.title: CBA sued for overcharging tens of thousands of businesses

item.dc:creator: Nick Bonyhady
item.description: The bank first reported problems to the regulator in 2019, but did not fully fix them for another seven years.
item.title: 66,000 NAB workers owed $169 million in mass underpayment

item.dc:creator: Michelle Cazzulino
item.description: I see now the error of my bargain-seeking ways and promise to do all my Christmas shopping with DJs, if I can find a store that’s still open.
item.title: Please come back, David Jones. I’ll forgive you if you’ll forgive me

item.dc:creator: Bloomberg News
item.description: BYD apologised for an assembly mistake that meant some of its Great Tang electric sport utility vehicles had their front and rear wheel rims installed in reverse.
item.title: Chinese car giant BYD apologises after putting wheels on the wrong way
